# LLM entry point

Primary instructions: `AGENTS.md`
Research design: `PROJECT_PLAN.md`
Live checklist: `reports/PREP_STATUS.md`
Run history: `reports/CHANGELOG_RUNS.md`
Known pitfalls: `reports/MISTAKES.md`
Course corpus: `llm_corpus/INDEX.md`

Core rule: all models receive identical prompts; all predictive evaluation is grouped by `prompt_id`.
Core claim limit: results concern the selected versions and prompts, not all LLM generations.
